Offroad_TemperatureTooHigh.text: Device temperature too high. System cooling down before starting. Current internal component temperature: %1

Offroad_ConnectivityNeededPrompt.text: Immediately connect to the internet to check for updates. If you do not connect to the internet, openpilot won't engage in %1
Offroad_ConnectivityNeededPrompt._comment: Set extra field to number of days

Offroad_ConnectivityNeeded.text: Connect to internet to check for updates. openpilot won't automatically start until it connects to internet to check for updates.

Offroad_UpdateFailed._comment: Set extra field to the failed reason.

Offroad_InvalidTime.text: Invalid date and time settings, system won't start. Connect to internet to set time.

Offroad_IsTakingSnapshot.text: Taking camera snapshots. System won't start until finished.

Offroad_NeosUpdate.text: An update to your device's operating system is downloading in the background. You will be prompted to update when it's ready to install.

Offroad_UnofficialHardware.text: Device failed to register. It will not connect to or upload to comma.ai servers, and receives no support from comma.ai. If this is an official device, visit https://comma.ai/support.

Offroad_BadNvme.text: Unsupported NVMe drive detected. Device may draw significantly more power and overheat due to the unsupported NVMe.

Offroad_CarUnrecognized.text: openpilot was unable to identify your car. Your car is either unsupported or its ECUs are not recognized. Please submit a pull request to add the firmware versions to the proper vehicle. Need help? Join discord.comma.ai.

Offroad_NoFirmware.text: openpilot was unable to identify your car. Check integrity of cables and ensure all connections are secure, particularly that the comma power is fully inserted in the OBD-II port of the vehicle. Need help? Join discord.comma.ai.

Offroad_Recalibration.text: openpilot detected a change in the device's mounting position. Ensure the device is fully seated in the mount and the mount is firmly secured to the windshield.

Offroad_SmartEco12VLow.text: Battery voltage is below the safety threshold as a result of a weak battery. Inspect the battery terminals for corrosion or looseness first, then charge your battery to avoid being stranded.

Offroad_SmartEco12VCold.text: Low battery voltage in cold weather. Cold temporarily lowers 12V battery voltage, and a weak 12V can keep the car from powering on. Inspect the terminals, then charge your battery. If it stays low once warmed up, have it load tested.

Offroad_SmartEco12VDrain.text: 12V battery dropped %1 V in 2 hours while parked. A healthy battery holds steady once the car is asleep. Inspect the terminals and check for anything left on. If it keeps happening, have the battery load tested.

Offroad_SmartEco12VRepeat.text: Low battery threshold triggered repeatedly. Please take your battery to be load tested at the nearest auto parts store.
